title: 6 New Perfumes You Can Try Before You Buy (With Perfume Testers)
summary: This month's new arrivals, from a skin-like gourmand to a werewolf-inspired scent, are easy to explore with perfume testers before you commit.
body_markdown:
Sometimes, finding your next signature scent means stepping outside your usual fragrance preferences. Maybe that’s trading your go-to vanilla for something smoky and unexpected, or discovering that a fruity, woody blend is more your style than a fresh citrus fragrance. Either way, exploring new perfumes is part of the fun, especially when perfume testers let you try them before committing to a full-size bottle.


This month’s new arrivals offer plenty of reasons to experiment, from a skin-like gourmand to a fragrance inspired by werewolf folklore and a woody scent with a juicy mango twist. If you’ve been looking for an excuse to refresh your fragrance rotation, these six launches are worth getting to know. Consider them a starting point for discovering what you love, one scent at a time.


## 6 new perfume testers worth trying


Whether you’re drawn to warm, comforting notes or prefer something with a little more edge, these new arrivals offer different ways to explore your fragrance preferences. And with perfume testers, you can spend time getting to know a scent on your skin before deciding if it’s one you’ll want to wear on repeat.


### [CLEAN BEAUTY COLLECTIVE Skin Intense](https://www.scentbird.com/brand/clean-reserve)


If you love fragrances that sit close to the skin but still leave an impression, Skin Intense is worth exploring. Creamy vanilla and caramelized sugar bring a smooth, sweet quality, while sea salt and musk keep the composition from feeling too dessert-like. The result is a warm, intimate gourmand with a sensual edge.


### [HERETIC PARFUM Werwulf](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/heretic-parfum-werwulf-212120663035594)


Inspired by the dark atmosphere of werewolf folklore, Werwulf takes a more mysterious approach to fragrance. Aromatic herbs, cardamom, and resinous woods evoke a forest after dark, while earthy vetiver and soft musk give the composition a grounded finish. It’s an intriguing option for anyone who prefers their fragrances atmospheric rather than conventionally sweet.


### [HUNGER GAMES x SCENTBIRD Sunrise on the Reaping](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/the-hunger-games-x-scentbird-sunrise-on-the-reaping-197836082957097)


This exclusive fragrance pairs juicy fruit with a greener, more unexpected finish. Wild berries and apple bring brightness to the opening, while golden daisy adds a floral touch. Butterfly bush and meadow moss round things out with an untamed, earthy quality, creating a contrast between sweetness and the natural world.


### [LIIS Celestial Object](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/liis-celestial-object-16307356119219)


LIIS Celestial Object explores a softer, more abstract side of perfumery. Quince lends a fruity brightness, while pink pepper introduces a subtle spice; incense and almond bring warmth and texture to the composition. The overall impression is a thoughtful balance of airy freshness and gentle warmth, ideal for those who enjoy fragrances that feel understated yet distinctive.


### [SCENTS OF WOOD Black Mango Vetiver](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/scents-of-wood-black-mango-vetiver-275756919155575)


Mango and vetiver might not be the first pairing that comes to mind, but that’s precisely what makes this fragrance interesting. Ripe black mango brings a juicy, tropical quality, while ginger and jasmine add spice and floral warmth. Vetiver, incense, and amber deepen the dry-down, balancing the fruitiness with an earthy, resinous finish.


### [TRU WESTERN Wrangler 1947](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/tru-western-wrangler-1947-76632841072777)


For something fresh with a rugged edge, Wrangler 1947 combines the crisp character of pink pepper with cedarwood and warm amber. A ranch-water-inspired accord adds a bright, cocktail-like twist, giving the fragrance a relaxed feel that calls to mind warm afternoons and easygoing evenings. It’s a distinctive option if you enjoy woody scents with a refreshing side.


## Explore perfume testers with Scentbird


Curious about a new fragrance but not ready to commit to a full-size bottle? Perfume testers are a practical way to explore different scents and discover how they wear on your skin. With[Scentbird](https://www.scentbird.com/) , you can try designer and niche fragrances through an 8 ml vial delivered each month, giving you time to experience a scent beyond the first spray.


Whether you’re curious about a creamy gourmand, a smoky woody fragrance, or something completely outside your usual rotation, sampling lets you experiment at your own pace. It’s a simple way to find fragrances you’ll genuinely enjoy wearing before investing in a full-size bottle.


## Frequently asked questions


### What are perfume testers, and how do they work?


Perfume testers are small samples, usually a spray vial, that let you wear a fragrance on your skin for days or weeks before deciding on a full-size bottle. With Scentbird, you get an 8 mL vial delivered each month, which gives you real time to see how a scent develops rather than judging it off the first spray.


### What’s a good pick for someone who loves skin-like, musky scents?


Clean Reserve’s Skin Intense is built around creamy vanilla and caramelized sugar, with sea salt and musk keeping it from feeling too dessert-like, making it a strong choice for anyone who wants a close-to-skin, intimate gourmand.


### Is Heretic Parfum Werwulf a sweet or a dark fragrance?


Dark and atmospheric rather than sweet. It’s built around rose, osmanthus, iris, and violet, grounded by vanilla, benzoin, labdanum, and vetiver, giving it a mysterious, forest-after-dark character rather than a conventionally sweet one.


### What does Sunrise on the Reaping smell like?


This Hunger Games x Scentbird exclusive opens with wild berries and apple, moves into golden daisy, and settles into butterfly bush and meadow moss, balancing bright fruit with an untamed, earthy quality.


### How do I know if a new perfume is right for me before buying a full bottle?


Wear a tester for at least a few hours, since opening notes can be very different from how a fragrance smells later on. Perfume testers make this easy because you’re not committing to a full bottle just to see how something develops on your skin.
